en.title: Virginia Law Boosts Movie Theater Accessibility for Disabled Patrons
en.summary: Virginia has enacted a new law requiring wheelchair-accessible seating, assistive listening devices, and closed captioning in movie theaters to improve access for patrons with disabilities. Meanwhile, New York City is rolling out accessibility upgrades at five subway stations, and Microsoft Edge released developer tools to enhance keyboard accessibility and fix layout gaps. A Sense report shows over half of English parents struggle to find accessible holiday clubs for disabled children, while a Werth family donation funds expanded accessible testing environments at Virginia Tech.

highlights.title: Law aims to improve accessibility at Va. movie theaters
NYC subway accessibility upgrades cover five stations - Railway Supply
New in Edge for developers – Style layout gaps, improve keyboard accessibility and migrate your PWA to a new origin
More than half of English parents struggle to find accessible holiday clubs for disabled children
New Werth gift expands accessible testing environments

zh-TW.title: 維吉尼亞州新法提升電影院無障礙，惠及殘障觀眾
zh-TW.summary: 維吉尼亞州已實施新法，要求電影院提供輪椅座位、助聽設備及閉路字幕，以改善殘障人士的觀影體驗。同時，紐約地鐵正在五個車站進行無障礙升級，微軟Edge釋出開發者功能以改善鍵盤無障礙與版面間距。英國 Sense 報告顯示超過半數家長難以尋找殘障兒童的可及假期俱樂部，而日本用戶在推特指出JR高速巴士殘障折扣使用時未檢查手冊，引發驗證疑慮。

highlights.title: 法律旨在改善維吉尼亞州電影院的無障礙設施
紐約地鐵無障礙升級覆蓋五個車站
Edge開發者新功能 – 樣式佈局間距、改進鍵盤無障礙及將PWA遷移至新來源
超過半數英國家長難為殘障兒童尋找可及的假期俱樂部
JR high-speed bus disability discount usage reported without handbook verification
